statements.text: Assessment: acute herpes zoster in a left L1 dermatomal distribution with associated pain; vesicular rash first noted 09/18/2026.
MRI thoracolumbar spine 09/03/2026: no compressive lesion; enhancement of the left L1 nerve root consistent with zoster radiculitis.
Pain limits walking to about one block and has forced the patient to stop volunteering; sleep is disrupted most nights.
Baseline VAS prior to any intervention: 73 mm.
Symptoms began on 09/16/2026, 2 weeks before this visit.
Pain persists despite valacyclovir and gabapentin titrated to 900 mg daily; refractory to conservative management.
Remains engaged in a home exercise program five days a week.
No red flags: afebrile, no unexplained weight loss, no history of malignancy, no saddle anesthesia.
